title: Configure CronJob & Manual Job Run
prompt:
A scheduled nightly cleanup task must run safely without overlapping executions in namespace `cka-cron`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Create CronJob `log-rotate` in namespace `cka-cron` with schedule `"*/15 * * * *"`, `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid`, and `successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 2`, running container `busybox:1.36` with command `["sh", "-c", "echo rotated && date"]` (`restartPolicy: OnFailure`).
2. Trigger an immediate one-off Job named `log-rotate-now` from CronJob `log-rotate` and ensure it completes (`succeeded >= 1`).
hints: Scaffold with `k -n cka-cron create cronjob log-rotate --image=busybox:1.36 --schedule="*/15 * * * *" $do -- sh -c 'echo rotated && date'`.
Trigger an immediate run with `k -n cka-cron create job --from=cronjob/log-rotate log-rotate-now`.
fast_solution_commands: k -n cka-cron create cronjob log-rotate --image=busybox:1.36 --schedule='*/15 * * * *' -- sh -c 'echo rotated && date'

checks.description: CronJob `log-rotate` sets concurrencyPolicy Forbid and historyLimit 2

manifests:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: log-rotate
  namespace: cka-cron
spec:
  schedule: "*/15 * * * *"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 2
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
          - name: rotate
            image: busybox:1.36
            command: ["sh", "-c", "echo rotated && date"]

reference_solution: Apply the CronJob manifest with `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid`, then run `kubectl create job --from=cronjob/log-rotate log-rotate-now`.
